nodes.description: mapping(address => Checkpoint[]) self.balances - historical token balances per address
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) self.allowed - ERC20 allowances
mapping(address => StakeInfo) self.stakerDetails - staking status and start dates
mapping(uint256 => Dispute) self.disputesById - dispute records with tally and vote flags
mapping(bytes32 => uint256) self.uintVars - global uint parameters (stakeAmount, disputeFee, stakerCount, total_supply, etc.)
mapping(uint256 => Request) self.requestDetails - per-request mined values, tips and dispute flags
mapping(bytes32 => address) self.addressVars - owner, deity and tellorContract addresses
uint256[51] self.requestQ - top-50 request payout pool indices
mapping(bytes32 => uint256) self.disputeIdByDisputeHash - hash to originating dispute id
mapping(uint256 => uint256) self.requestIdByRequestQIndex - queue position to request id
msg.sender - caller controlled address used for transfers, voting, staking and fee payers
block.timestamp (now) - used for dispute deadlines, voting windows and stake timing
transfer(self,_to,_amount) - sends tokens from msg.sender to _to
transferFrom(self,_from,_to,_amount) - allowance checked transfer, decrements allowance
approve(self,_spender,_amount) - sets allowance for spender
doTransfer(self,_from,_to,_amount) - core balance mutation routine emitting Transfer
balanceOfAt(self,_user,_blockNumber) - binary search of historical checkpoint balance
allowedToTrade(self,_user,_amount) - true if balance minus locked stake covers amount
updateBalanceAtNow(checkpoints,_value) - writes a new Checkpoint for the current block
beginDispute(self,_requestId,_timestamp,_minerIndex) - opens a dispute and takes the dispute fee
vote(self,_disputeId,_supportsDispute) - casts weighted vote on a dispute
tallyVotes(self,_disputeId) - finalizes votes, locks or slashes stake after minExecutionDate
proposeFork(self,_propNewTellorAddress) - charges 100e18 fork fee and opens fork dispute
updateTellor(self,_disputeId) - switches tellorContract address after a successful fork vote
unlockDisputeFee(self,_disputeId) - distributes fees or slash proceeds after voting window
updateMinDisputeFee(self) - recomputes disputeFee from stakeAmount and stakerCount
init(self) - bootstraps supply, initial 6 miners and constant parameters
requestStakingWithdraw(self) - locks stake for 7 days and decrements stakerCount
withdrawStake(self) - releases stake after the 7 day lock using timestamp checks
depositStake(self) - stakes msg.sender and re-adjusts disputeFee
newStake(self,staker) - internal staking routine updating status and stakerCount
SafeMath.add(int256,uint256) - checked addition with assertion
SafeMath.sub(int256,uint256) - checked subtraction with assertion
SafeMath.mul(uint256) - checked multiplication with overflow assertion
SafeMath.max(uint256/int256) - returns larger argument
SafeMath.min(uint256) - returns smaller argument
getMax5(uint256[51]) - returns top-5 values and indices from the request queue
getMax(uint256[51]) - returns maximum value and index of queue array
self.allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _amount in transferFrom - raw unchecked allowance decrement
previousBalance - _amount in doTransfer - raw unchecked sender balance subtraction
self.uintVars[stakerCount] -= 1 in requestStakingWithdraw - raw unchecked staker counter decrement
now >= minExecutionDate and now - tallyDate > 1 days in tallyVotes - timestamp dependent settlement gate
updateMinDisputeFee fee formula with nested min/targetMiners divisions - arithmetic sensitive computation
self.uintVars[stakerCount] -= 1 in unlockDisputeFee - raw unchecked staker counter decrement on slashing
_to - recipient address parameter of TellorTransfer.transfer
_amount - token amount parameter of TellorTransfer.transfer
_from - source address parameter of TellorTransfer.transferFrom
_minerIndex - slot of the disputed miner in TellorDispute.beginDispute
_disputeId - dispute identifier parameter of TellorDispute.vote
_propNewTellorAddress - proposed fork address parameter of proposeFork
voteWeight - balance checkpoint value used to weight a dispute vote
_fee - dispute fee computed in beginDispute before transfer to the contract
previousBalance - balance snapshot used in doTransfer before mutation
stakes - StakeInfo storage pointer for msg.sender in requestStakingWithdraw

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only a recipient argument of transfer and carries no independent semantics
_amount is only the value argument of transfer
_from is only the source argument of transferFrom
_minerIndex only selects a slot inside beginDispute
_disputeId only indexes the dispute inside vote
voteWeight is computed and used solely within vote
_fee is computed and spent solely within beginDispute
previousBalance is a transient snapshot inside doTransfer
stakes is a storage pointer used only inside requestStakingWithdraw
